objective: Improve every owner-controlled product, capability, agent, architecture, verification, security, documentation, report, knowledge, and repository-governance surface without fabricating excluded release, provider, adoption, or real-world outcome evidence.
exclusions: real-world SEO effectiveness and external reproduction
provider or deployed SEO-effectiveness, adoption, ranking, traffic, conversion, and community-growth claims

phases.title: Program controls and current-state audit
phases.rollback: Revert the Phase 0 program, validator, tests, and CI invocation as one bounded change.

acceptance_criteria.description: The validator rejects phase skipping and incomplete phase closure.
Every resolved failure requires a linked recurrence guardrail before phase completion.
Excluded evidence classes cannot be promoted to a passing completion claim.

phases.title: Immediate repository security and governance
phases.rollback: Restore the recorded repository settings and revert only the Phase 1 workflow and documentation changes.

acceptance_criteria.description: The documented vulnerability-reporting and support paths resolve to enabled destinations.
Main requires repository certification and independent review for material changes.

phases.title: Canonical product and capability contract
phases.rollback: Revert the canonical product contract and generated references while preserving executable compatibility.

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical product terminology is consistent across validated authorities.
Every command and capability has an honest machine-readable evidence classification.

phases.title: Architecture and verification foundation
phases.rollback: Revert each bounded refactor with its compatibility tests; do not roll back unrelated user work.

acceptance_criteria.description: Critical runtime boundaries use typed contracts and validated dependency direction.
Complexity, typing, lint, and coverage ratchets reject new debt.

phases.title: Executable capability depth and failure semantics
phases.rollback: Revert one command family or analysis service at a time while retaining the prior public interface.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every registered command maps to a handler, schema, tests, evidence mode, and failure contract.
Missing, stale, duplicate, and contradictory evidence produce truthful deterministic states.

phases.title: Agent differentiation and handoff governance
phases.rollback: Restore the previous capability bundle and routing records if compatibility or ownership tests fail.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every retained agent has distinct evidence, tools, policy, or deterministic output responsibility.
Required handoffs are consumed or explicitly reported unresolved.

phases.title: Transport and local-data security hardening
phases.rollback: Revert each security boundary only if legitimate compatibility tests fail; never restore a proven unsafe behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every outbound transport enforces or delegates to one canonical security policy.
Credentials and private evidence cannot cross unapproved redirects, logs, telemetry, or examples.

phases.title: Reports documentation onboarding and knowledge
phases.rollback: Revert generated and canonical documentation together and retain schema backward compatibility.

acceptance_criteria.description: Material report values and scores are reproducible and evidence-bound.
Onboarding, support, counts, commands, matrices, and knowledge freshness are validator-backed.

phases.title: Repository operations and integrated re-audit
phases.rollback: Revert repository-operation documents and settings individually while preserving the verified source improvements.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every controllable critical path has an owner, issue, runbook, verification, and rollback trigger.
The integrated source passes full certification and two independent fresh-context reviews.

audit_findings.summary: Improvement-cycle approval could be forged with empty implementation and evidence arrays.
audit_findings.remediation: Require non-empty implementation, test, evidence, and learning records in schema and evaluator.
audit_findings.acceptance: A recomputed reviewer hash cannot turn an empty evidence package into approval.

audit_findings.summary: Repository security reporting and main-branch controls require live setting verification.
audit_findings.remediation: Align documented private reporting and required certification with enabled GitHub settings.
audit_findings.acceptance: Live repository settings and documented paths agree and material changes require review.

audit_findings.summary: Product identity and maturity wording are not enforced across every metadata surface.
audit_findings.remediation: Create one canonical maturity-qualified product contract and validate every authority against it.
audit_findings.acceptance: Blocked superiority or production-readiness wording fails deterministic validation.

audit_findings.summary: Large modules and partial typing need ratchets that prevent new maintainability debt.
audit_findings.remediation: Add typed boundary contracts, complexity budgets, full linting, and adverse-path coverage ratchets.
audit_findings.acceptance: Certification rejects new complexity, typing, lint, dependency-direction, or critical coverage debt.

audit_findings.summary: Invalid CLI arguments bypass the documented single JSON-envelope command contract.
audit_findings.remediation: Use one non-exiting parser error adapter with stable command IDs and error codes.
audit_findings.acceptance: Every registered invalid invocation emits exactly one valid JSON envelope and exits two.

audit_findings.summary: Comparative inventory validation omits effective command and capability overlays.
audit_findings.remediation: Hash and validate the effective merged registries, including every overlay.
audit_findings.acceptance: Mutating either overlay makes comparative freshness validation fail.

audit_findings.summary: Most agent documents disagree with runtime capability skills or template selection.
audit_findings.remediation: Define primary, supplemental, and execution-class fields once and generate or validate agent declarations.
audit_findings.acceptance: All agent documents exactly match resolved bundles and advisory agents are visibly classified.

audit_findings.summary: Agent handoff completion and specialist differentiation are incompletely measured.
audit_findings.remediation: Add responsibility, overlap, handoff-consumption, and specialist evaluation matrices.
audit_findings.acceptance: Every retained agent has a distinct tested responsibility and every required handoff is consumed or reported.

audit_findings.summary: Legacy rendered-page fetching can follow a validated public URL to an unvalidated private redirect.
audit_findings.remediation: Route all rendered-page requests and redirects through the canonical bounded transport.
audit_findings.acceptance: A public-to-private redirect target is rejected before any request reaches it.

audit_findings.summary: Credential-bearing LLM requests follow redirects and retry permanent failures too broadly.
audit_findings.remediation: Disable unsafe credential redirects and retry only explicitly transient responses or network faults.
audit_findings.acceptance: Credentials never cross hosts and permanent, malformed, or oversized failures execute once.

audit_findings.summary: Timed-out threaded tools can continue side effects after the runtime reports failure.
audit_findings.remediation: Introduce determinate deadlines or indeterminate outcomes with stable operation identity and safe retry rules.
audit_findings.acceptance: A timeout cannot cause an untracked duplicate side effect or a false definitive failure.

audit_findings.summary: Local evidence privacy and several outbound integration boundaries are platform-incomplete.
audit_findings.remediation: Enforce Windows-aware private storage, bounded token endpoints, immutable actions, and transport inventory tests.
audit_findings.acceptance: Platform and mutation tests prove private storage and every credentialed transport boundary.

audit_findings.summary: Deterministic rule contributions are mislabeled as executed agents and reports obscure fixture evidence mode.
audit_findings.remediation: Version contribution semantics and render evidence mode, ownership, verification, and missing evidence prominently.
audit_findings.acceptance: No artifact claims agent execution without executor evidence and every report labels FIXTURE or LIVE_BOUNDED.

audit_findings.summary: Documentation certification, artifact counts, command authority, and source freshness exceed observed evidence.
audit_findings.remediation: Derive claims from immutable evidence and distinguish static metadata validation from live source review.
audit_findings.acceptance: Docs, artifact inventory, command arguments, and per-source freshness are generated or validator-backed.

audit_findings.summary: Support, conduct reporting, ownership depth, and repository operations need explicit accountable paths.
audit_findings.remediation: Provide private reporting, canonical issue intake, ownership backups, runbooks, and governance metrics.
audit_findings.acceptance: Every controllable repository path has an owner, working intake, runbook, verification, and rollback trigger.
